projects.title: Deep Recursive Array & Object Flattener
projects.description: Implement a recursive flattener that unpacks deeply nested multi-dimensional arrays and objects into a flat single-level structure.
projects.exampleOutput: Deeply flattened result: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
projects.learningOutcome: Mastering recursion, stack depth management, and array accumulator pipelines.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Recursive Decomposition**:
For each item, if `Array.isArray(item)` is true, recursively invoke `deepFlatten(item)`; otherwise append the primitive value.
2. **Tail Call & Stack Overflow Guard**:
For extremely deep arrays (10,000+ levels), an iterative stack-based approach using `while (stack.length)` avoids Call Stack overflow (`RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`).
projects.codeExplanation: The solution demonstrates both recursive and iterative stack-based flattening algorithms.

projects.title: High-Performance Function Memoizer with Cache Eviction
projects.description: Build a generic memoize higher-order function that caches expensive computation results and supports LRU (Least Recently Used) cache eviction.
projects.exampleOutput: Fibonacci(40) computed in 0.05ms using memoization cache
projects.learningOutcome: Using memoization to convert $O(2^N)$ exponential algorithms into $O(N)$ linear time.
projects.logicExplanation:
1. **Dynamic Programming via Memoization**:
Pure functions always return the same output for identical inputs. Caching results in an in-memory hash map avoids redundant recursive sub-tree calculations.
2. **Map vs Object Cache**:
`Map` maintains insertion order and accepts any key type, making it ideal for LRU cache eviction.
projects.codeExplanation: The script implements `memoize` and proves an exponential speedup on recursive computations.
